svg.title: What refine_knowledge does. It takes the documents that passed grading, splits each into knowledge strips, one line each, scores every strip from 0 to 1 against the question in one batch of model calls, and keeps only the strips that score above 0.5. Those become knowledge_strips, which decide_to_generate checks: some left means generate, none left means transform_query and the web.
